subject: [PATCH v3 4/7] selftests/mm: check that MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT preserve shared memory

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch adds a selftest to verify that the MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT hints preserve shared memory. The test checks three scenarios: a dirty shared file page is either written back or left resident, shared anonymous memory is paged out through shmem, and a SHM_LOCK'd segment remains unevictable without its VMA being VM_LOCKED. The patch introduces new functionality to the selftest framework, including a fixture setup and teardown for the test, and uses existing functions such as pageout_until_swapped to implement the test logic.
